# PDS — Pella Design System

> React design system made for AI Agentic development, aiming for the perfect design system for AI vibe-coding users: clean, fast and flawless, updatable without any human supervisory. Radix UI primitives + Tailwind CSS v4 + CVA, shipped as a prebuilt ESM package with a token pipeline (tokens.json → generated CSS variables + TypeScript). Zero build step for consumers; runtime theming via configurePds() — theme changes are pure CSS custom-property updates on <html>, no re-render.

## Surface roles

Base and alternative are places, not colors. A component fills a container with a surface ROLE, never a
static palette step: bg-surface (the surface it stands on), bg-surface-card (container on it),
bg-surface-canvas (the deliberate opposite-tone inset), bg-surface-field, bg-surface-row, text-surface-fg.
Roles resolve per element from data-pds-surface, so a component inside an alternative column reads the
alternative tone even when the root is base. bg-background / bg-card / bg-secondary / bg-muted are fixed
steps and cannot do that — in dark mode background (#383838) and card (#1B1B1B) are different values.
Use a static step only when the token export declares one for that component; scripts/check-surface.mjs
fails the build on any new one and lists the recorded exceptions in scripts/surface-baseline.json.

## Install

pnpm add "https://github.com/pellaDev/PDS#main"    # or pin a release: #v1.10.1

## Quick start

import "@workspace/pds/styles.css";              // once, in the app entry
import { Button } from "@workspace/pds/components/ui/button";
import { configurePds, setPdsConfig } from "@workspace/pds/config";  // optional

configurePds({ lightBrand: "#0B5FFF", darkBrand: "#7AB8FF", font: "inter" }); // install flags (once at bootstrap)
setPdsConfig({ fieldStyle: "outline" });          // live update, persisted in localStorage

## Components (58)

accordion · alert · alert-dialog · aspect-ratio · avatar · badge · breadcrumb · button · calendar · card · carousel · chart · checkbox · color-picker · collapsible · command · dialog · device · drawer · empty · field · form · hover-card · icon · input · input-otp · item · kbd · label · layout · menu · menubar · mobile-navigation-menu · navigation-menu · pagination · popover · progress · radio · resizable · scroll-area · separator · sheet · sidebar · skeleton · slider · sonner · spinner · sticky-action-bar · switch · table · tabs · tag · template · textarea · toast · toaster · toggle · tooltip

PDS additions beyond the shadcn/ui registry: color-picker, device, icon, layout, menu, mobile-navigation-menu, tag, toast, toaster (radio follows the shadcn RadioGroup API). ToggleGroup lives in the `toggle` module. Not included: select, dropdown-menu, context-menu, button-group, input-group, native-select.

## Exports

- @workspace/pds | /tokens — generated token values + types
- @workspace/pds/styles.css — generated CSS theme
- @workspace/pds/config — runtime configuration (brand colors, field style, font)
- @workspace/pds/components/* · /lib/* · /hooks/* — components, utilities, hooks

## Optional dependencies

Install only if you use the component: chart→recharts · carousel→embla-carousel-react · drawer→vaul · command→cmdk · sonner→sonner. framer-motion is not required by PDS (removed in v1.5.0).
